svg.text: WHY THIS IS THE CHEAPEST PART OF THE REUSE ROUTE

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: It is free, and it is not a job.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the connectors stay on the pressing, and the pressing stays on the chassis. Nothing to unbolt.

svg.text: ISO 10487 standardises the connector, not the pinout — A4 and A7 get swapped. True of a bought adapter too.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ⚠️ Layout is indicative — every manufacturer arranges the back panel differently. The connector standards are not.
